searchText: It seems finalizing `eth/69` (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9237) still needs input as well. I believe we still need sign-off from Erigon, NimbusEL, and EthereumJS. Meta EIP for history expiry PR open. Currently marked as draft, but I'm ready for suggestions if anyone has any they'd like to give: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9572 yeah, there is also still a discussion going on here around the spec: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1353744275099222066 it is not fully ready yet What can I do to help move that towards a decision? Should we schedule a call or breakout for EL teams to discuss? Is async discussion in that thread or github issue sufficient? What (if anything) is currently blocked by that not being finalized? A breakout call would be nice as currently we only have opinions from Nethermind and Geth around the spec and we havent heard from other execution clients on it. Left some comments here 🌷 <@687974325072035882> <@524738020033691659> I am merging https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9331 let me know if you still have feedback about it
